H1.criterion: Per scale with >=2 proof records, all records share identical canonicalJson({digests, goldMetrics}).

H2.criterion: Every tamper verdict conforms to its rederivedDisposition rule (fail-closed => verifyStatus in {fail,crash} & fingerprintMatch; accepted/acknowledged-limitation => pass & fingerprintMatch; dropped => pass), every dispositionMatch===true, and the per-disposition counts equal the protocol.tamperMatrix bucket lengths.

H3.criterion: resume-reconciliation reports dupTotal===0, gapTotal===0, and finalMultisetMatch===true.

claim: Under the recorded environment (pinned node version, platform, and instrument commit), the memory-baseline evidence instrument is replay-deterministic (identical digests over N independent replays at 1k and 1M scale), tamper-evident for the enumerated tamper matrix (every class in the fail-closed set fails closed with its pre-registered fingerprint, including classes that leave surface scores perfect), and campaign-operable (an unattended batch completed with every iteration ending in a machine-checkable proof record or an explicit stop record, surviving the probed interruption classes — process kill at an iteration boundary and mid-iteration — without duplication or gaps).
